The '''Narrant sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi]], [[Tashtor sector|Tashtor]], [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla]], [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak]] and [[Corbett sector/Legends|Corbett sectors]] in the Mid Rim.
